title: Focus group on effector gene prediction: Thursday November 14
summary: Please join us on Thursday Nov. 14 for a focus group discussion on effector gene prediction for common traits and diseases.
bodyHtml:
Please join us this Thursday for a focus group discussion on effector gene prediction for common traits and diseases! We’ll review our research into current methods and presentation formats, and talk about the outcome of the community workshop that we held in September.

Details on joining the presentation are below and are also embedded in this flyer. Please circulate it to interested colleagues! We hope to see you there, but we’ll also record and post the presentation for those who can’t make it.
